Jiang Xu.

Seong Muyeon, the seventh son of the Demon Cult Leader and a sufferer of severed meridians syndrome, realizes that he has been reincarnated as a character in the martial arts novel “Supreme Sword Chronicle.”
According to the original plot, the Demon Cult is utterly destroyed by the protagonist Baek Ryeoil.
Using recuperation as an excuse, he sneaks out of the Demon Cult’s headquarters, but……
“What business do you have in the Central Plains? What filthy scheme are you plotting?”
Of all people, he gets caught by Baek Ryeoil himself.
At this point, there’s no other choice.
If he can’t avoid being killed by the protagonist,
it’s better to cling to him instead!
“Please hide me. You wanted to catch me anyway, didn’t you?”
“No.”
“But you’re the most trustworthy in the whole sect!”
Through desperate flattery, he somehow manages to enter the righteous sect, but there’s no way life will be easy for Seong Muyeon, a former demon cultist.
After a series of incidents, Seong Muyeon’s severed meridians syndrome flares up again, 
and Baek Ryeoil makes a suggestion——
“Just do dual cultivation with me.”
▶ A Quick Taste
It felt like Seong Muyeon’s soul was leaving his body through his mouth. He held his forehead.
“……Please explain in more detail.”
“One of the treatments for severed meridians is to perform dual cultivation with someone who has at least one Jiazi¹ worth of internal energy.”
‘I already know that!’
Countless heroines in the martial arts world had their illnesses cured thanks to the protagonist’s grace. As expected of the main character, Baek Ryeoil had an immense amount of internal energy.
“If that’s one method, what are the others?”
“Become a Huajing master and completely transform your body.”
Baek Ryeoil looked Seong Muyeon up and down.
“Judging by your current state, you’d have a better chance coming back from the dead.”
“……”
“This is the easiest. Besides, all the ingredients are right here.”
Baek Ryeoil pointed at himself, his eyes gleaming.
“I refuse.”
Seong Muyeon rejected him on the spot and turned away without hesitation.
“Why not!”
“Just because.”
¹ Jiazi (甲子): A traditional Chinese time unit equal to a 60-year cycle. In martial arts fiction, it often symbolizes a high level of internal cultivation.

117256.synopsis:
The day after a painful breakup, Shu Yao is introduced to a matchmaking event by a friend.
There, she takes a liking to Director Lin from Nanshan Hospital, a cold beauty and a renowned virtuoso surgeon.
The beautiful Dr. Lin is gentle and considerate. She picks Shu Yao up from work every day, leaning against her red car, her ink-black hair falling over her shoulders, the shadows of her thick, long eyelashes gracing her eyes.
She is always so affectionate, reluctant to part, as if she cherishes Shu Yao completely—a feeling Shu Yao thoroughly enjoys.
Until one time, after getting drunk and running into her ex-girlfriend, Shu Yao returns home and tearfully pours her heart out while hugging Director Lin’s slender waist, asking, “Will you… will you cheat on me like she did?”
Lin Ran falls silent.
From the soft plaid sofa, a mottled black-and-red tentacle emerges, followed by a second, and a third… They unfurl and sway before Shu Yao like a peac*ck displaying its feathers.
Her gentle girlfriend then asks at the perfect moment: “Which one are you asking about?”
Shu Yao: “……!”
She lets out a hiccup, scared sober.
*
No one knows that every night, as Lin Ran waits in the shadows by her car after dropping Shu Yao home, twisted and grotesque tent**les whisper encouragement in her ear:
“Cuddle… we want to cuddle…”
“Eat her, then we can cuddle forever!”
“A hug… so warm… we want to go somewhere warmer…”

117768.synopsis:
Jiang Liu woke up one day to find he’d transmigrated to a parallel world, where a game called Cultivation Era was about to launch. The Earth was about to undergo cultivationization! Game characters and real life would be fully integrated! A nationwide era of cultivation was dawning!
The free content in the game was pretty generous, including but not limited to: open world exploration, main storyline quests, the Tower of Heaven, leaderboards, arena battles, and exciting events.
As for the pay-to-play content, it was absolutely massive, including but not limited to: top-up 648 yuan to get giant wings and luxury outfits, draw from a limited-time card pool for maxed sword spirit roots and supreme celestial bodies, invest spirit stones to get a perfect Foundation Establishment and Nine-Turn Golden Core, unlock one-click auto-cultivation at VIP5, and romance 100 gorgeous immortal companions with special relationship items.
Free-to-play players had to s*ave away for three years just to reach Foundation Establishment! Meanwhile, rich whales could auto-cultivate all the way to Ascension!
“This game could’ve been great, but the devs screwed it up, and there are still tons of bugs!”
“I’ve been cultivating for three years, and I lost my house, my wife left me—what did I do wrong? All I wanted was to cultivate!”
“Nationwide cultivation? If you don’t have money, how the h*ll are you supposed to cultivate?”
“Come on, take out a microloan to boost your cultivation! Don’t you want that perfect Foundation Establishment?”
Jiang Liu: “Pay-to-win cultivation? With my 90% off cracked client, I’m about to have the time of my life!”
associated_names: 这是修仙游戏，但运营烂了

118536.synopsis:
⚠This work contains scenes that may induce discomfort or fear. Please take this into consideration before reading.
When he comes back to life, he loses all his memories.
A man wakes up in a strange hotel. Room 712. He is killed repeatedly by a monster called a “creature,” and each time he comes back to life in Room 712, his memories are completely gone. One day, 712 encounters a middle-aged man in the hallway. They begin searching other rooms together, looking for a way to escape the hotel. While searching, 712 runs into a creature and faces death once again. He pleads for help from the middle-aged man, but the man only stands there, watching as 712 dies…
“Hold on, just a little longer!”
A second man suddenly appears in the nick of time.
Is he friend or foe?

118792.synopsis:
An innocent man is deemed guilty when he possesses a priceless treasure. In his previous life, the Elven power Ming Qingming obtained became the very blade that ended his life.
The wicked adults used every trick imaginable—deception, coercion, manipulation, and seduction—just to stain the young Elf with filth.
And so, the beautiful Elven girl became the enemy of the entire continent—and was even branded as the “Cancer of All Spirits.” She had power, but could protect no one.
Consumed by regret, anger, and despair, she took the civilization of Westeros to the end of Oblivion.
But in the unseen hands of fate, she was given a second chance…

119048.synopsis:
‘Jeonghyun’ steps foot into a certain mansion as a substitute for a high-paying private tutoring part-time job for three weeks. However, after encountering Jiwon’s younger brother, ‘Jihyuk,’ he keeps getting uncomfortably entangled with him, and ends up taking on not only Jiwon’s tutoring, whom he was originally supposed to teach, but Jihyuk’s as well.
Jeonghyun tries to stand firm in front of Jihyuk, who subtly gets on his nerves, but he feels like a danger signal goes off every time he is with Jihyuk.
However, by the time he tried to run away, he was already submerged up to his chest in a thick swamp, and in the end, for the sake of his precious family’s safety, Jeonghyun ends up selling his body to Jihyuk, the student he was teaching….

119304.synopsis:
Dragged into the world of a tr*sh-tier light novel, I figured my new noble title would let me coast through life and dodge the tragic fate that originally awaited me. 
But as it turns out I was wrong. 
Step by step, I’m being pushed toward a future I never asked for. 
This is the tale of an utterly ordinary man who has no choice but to become a hero.
Sweet words from the author before you dive in:
1. The story is written entirely in first person, but the “I” will switch between characters as the plot demands (the author is on the verge of a split personality).
2. When the protagonist gets knocked around, please cut him some slack. He’s just a regular guy and can’t always pick the perfect option. His late-game self will look very different from his early-game self.
3. Early chapters revolve around campus life and character drama. Fights are scarce; this isn’t a grind-for-XP adventure. Think of it as a Japanese school gal-game wearing a Western-fantasy skin.
4. The manuscript has already passed the one-million-word mark. Doesn’t that prove the author is now a properly trained digital author?
associated_names: 转生恶役贵族，异世界求生记

121352.synopsis:
After the mistress passed away, the grand Fernheim estate became cold and desolate.
Its only masters were Count Redelhardt, the very model of a noble gentleman, and his admiring son, Ian.
One day, Count Redelhardt brought home the daughter of a deceased friend.
It was only natural that Ian, who had spent his whole life at Fernheim, would fall for Mari, whose mysterious beauty was like that of a fairy.
Just as the boy’s first love was coming into bloom, Ian discovered by chance that Mari was being called to the count’s chambers every night.
With the bitter end of that love, he left Fernheim, cursing her.
Because he could never bring himself to despise the father he longed to be like.
And three years later,
Having come of age at the academy, Ian returned to Fernheim for his coming-of-age ceremony.
Still tormented by the memories of the past, he decided to shake them off, by spying on what took place in the count’s room.
But what he saw there was a secret about Mari he had never even imagined.
And that night…
“You saw it, didn’t you? Now your misunderstanding is cleared, right?”
Mari, who had been waiting for him, came to him.
“What is your desire, young master?”
As if she already knew his heart,
“Whatever it is, I’ll help you.”
She boldly seduced him…
* * *
“I’m sorry… I’m sorry, Mari…”
Murmuring his apology in a voice that seemed about to cry, the man’s relentless movements never ceased, pressing and grinding deep inside her without pause.
“It feels like I keep hurting you… but whenever I see you, I can’t help myself…”
Ian was crying. Not literal tears, but unable to withstand the overwhelming pleasure, he sniffled as he roughly withdrew and slammed himself in again and again.
“You can’t believe it, can you? How could someone who loves you do something like this…”

122376.synopsis:
During my part-time job, I witnessed a couple break up right in front of me.
Both the guy and the girl were familiar faces—after all, they’ve been my classmates since this spring.
However, I had no idea they were dating. They’re both popular at school… but there were never any rumors about them being together.
And yet, I definitely saw the moment they broke up with my own eyes.
And then, the girl who got dumped caught me watching.
associated_names: カップルが終わる瞬間、俺はその一部始終を見てしまった

126216.synopsis:
Protagonists and harems go hand in hand.
However, only one gets chosen.
This is an unchanging fact throughout all times and places.
The heroine who wasn’t chosen by the protagonist and went unrewarded──in other words, the pitiful losing heroine.
The future of a losing heroine is miserable.
She can’t be with the guy she likes.
In some cases, she has to watch him flirt with other women. It’s a mild form of hell.
「Why?! Why is everyone ignoring me?!」
「……What the hell is she doing?」
She──Orimoto Suzuka──is a losing heroine.
And there she was, screaming and shouting in front of the school gate. Yet everyone was ignoring her.
After saving the losing heroine who had been abandoned by the world, before I knew it, she was directing intensely heavy emotions toward me.
This is that kind of story──
「Hey, you can see me?」
「Koutarou will stay by my side forever, won’t you?」
「If things stay like this, with Koutarou-kun──」
Which way does my future lie──Kasugai Koutarou?
associated_names: Ore ni Dake Mieru Make Heroine (Fukusuu) ga Geki-Omoi Kanjou Sugiru
俺にだけ見える負けヒロイン（複数）が激重感情すぎる。

134664.synopsis:
Wei Miao wakes up to find herself reborn inside a novel called Overbearing CEO Series: School Belle Sweetheart, Don’t Even Think of Running.
 Her role? The vicious side character who’s hopelessly obsessed with the male lead and spends her time mocking and scheming against the heroine.
But after binding with a “positive energy system,” Wei Miao is given one task: save the ab*sed heroine. Otherwise, she won’t survive in this world.
So when the heroine can’t get into the dormitory;
 Wei Miao: I’ll help you.
When the heroine is bullied;
 Wei Miao: I’ll protect you.
When the heroine falls sick;
 Wei Miao: I’ll take care of you.
When the heroine’s in danger;
 Wei Miao: I’ll save you.
Until one day, the heroine Liang Qianwei, blushing bright red, wraps her arms around Wei Miao’s waist and says:
 “I want you.”
Wei Miao: ???
Since when was the heroine into girls? …Forget it, my life is yours anyway!
*******
Tags: Sweet romance · Transmigration into a novel · Feel-good story · School setting
Main Characters: Wei Miao, Liang Qianwei
Supporting Characters: Song Mengmeng, Wang Xiao, Lu Weinan
Other Keywords: Transmigration, GL
One-line summary: After saving the heroine, why is she suddenly acting… different?
Theme: Through persistent effort, one can earn a life full of positive energy.
associated_names: 穿书后，女主把我搞到手了？
穿書後，女主把我搞到手了？

135944.synopsis:
What should you do if you transmigrate into a game world that defies description?
Miss Fushia isn’t all that flustered. As a transmigrator, she too possesses the cheat that transmigrators are supposed to have. It is a method called the Word Game, which can present her future in the form of text. She can even choose from different options that will show her multiple possible futures, allowing her to know in advance what might happen.
And if the text of the Word Game isn’t clear enough, she can even choose to personally experience that part of the future.
“Eh? Why does it say here that I was taken by Her Highness the Princess to her room, where we spent a delightful night together? What exactly does a delightful night mean?”
Fushia thought for a moment, then chose to experience that future.
associated_names: 芙媞娅小姐的文字游戏

138760.synopsis:
Xie Xuan was wicked in life—and just as unrepentant in death. Denied reincarnation, she was cast into the sea of blood, doomed to fade into nothingness.
But before her soul vanished, she was saved by Feng Xun—the ghost king of Fengdu, a celestial being who descended from the upper realm. Pure-hearted and noble, he believed even the darkest souls could be redeemed.
He clothed Xie Xuan for the first time in human garments, taught her words, and guided her toward virtue. The first word she ever wrote was his name—Feng Xun.
Yet, what he thought was redemption became deception. Xie Xuan learned not purity, but pretense. Behind her gentle smile, she hid the cunning of a serpent. One day, dressed clumsily in rouge and pearls, she tried to trick Feng Xun into setting her free.
He looked at her for a long time, eyes soft beneath the ghost mask. “Is that it?” he asked—then kissed her brow and whispered, “I’ve taken the bait.”
Xie Xuan never understood what he meant—until much later.
Back in the mortal world, she fulfilled her vengeance. She burned kingdoms, spilled royal blood, and drove her dagger into the Crown Prince’s chest—only to see Feng Xun’s face emerge from the dying man’s features.
As his lifeless heart bled in her hands, she finally understood the cruelest truth of the gods—
A god can only be slain by the one he loves.
Years later, Xie Xuan rose again—not as a ghost, but as the ruler of the underworld. She conquered the heavens, captured the God King who bore Feng Xun’s face, and claimed him as her prisoner.
In the end, the sinner became the savior, the hunted became the hunter.
And love, in its most twisted form, conquered both heaven and hell.

143368.synopsis:
The First Military Academy’s elite combat division only recruits the strongest—students with powerful bloodlines and terrifying spirit forms, proudly claiming each one can fight ten.
This year, however, a strange special recruit arrives.
Wen Xiao is physically weak, can’t lift much, and in a crowd of wolves, tigers, and leopards, his spirit form is a soft, snow-white cat. The type that tilts its head and meows cutely.
Everyone treats him like a mascot… until the freshman exchange match, where his little white cat controls dozens of opponents in one go, letting the combat division sweep the team battle with zero effort.
Other departments: “…”
Other departments: “So your standard isn’t one vs ten, it’s one vs a hundred?!”
Wen Xiao always insists his spirit form is “very fierce” and doesn’t let people touch it.
But the cute cat loves rolling over, purring, and showing its belly—it doesn’t look fierce at all.
Everyone assumes it’s just an excuse to avoid being petted, until a simulation battle forces the white cat into its second form: a gluttonous Taotie that vacuums up all the star beasts in one terrifying gulp.
White cat: “Burp~”
Other departments: “???”
The combat division coughs and says, “Actually, our standard might be one vs a hundred.”
Wen Xiao’s bloodline has awakened; his spirit form holds two forms:
First form: White cat – control type.
Second form: Taotie – if control fails, then devour.
Another special recruit that year is Lu Qingran, heir of an old northern family, with SSS-level spiritual power. From day one, everyone bets on when Wen Xiao and Lu Qingran—whose families are famously at odds—will clash.
What no one knows is: the white cat that Wen Xiao won’t let others touch actually has two masters… and Lu Qingran is the other one.

155656.synopsis:
The usually proper and dignified Senpai turns into a useless mess thanks to my healing!?
Amemoto Touya is a high school student who loves healing and peace.
One night, Touya encounters the captain of the archery club, Watanuki Rino. There was something pitiful about the sight of her buying a massive amount of energy drinks at a convenience store…
Learning that Rino was working too hard every day to live up to the expectations of those around her, Touya resolved to help her.
As a result of Touya, who is well-versed in “healing,” giving it his all—
“Nngh… Ehehe.”
“She’s sleeping with a happy face again…”
Rino ended up spending all her time in Touya’s room!?
A reward-style rom-com where a usually dignified, super-strong Senpai becomes completely loose and defenseless in front of me!
associated_names: Kyuudou Bu no Bijin na Senpai ga, Ore no Heya de Onaka Dashite Neteru
The Beautiful Senpai from the Archery Club Is Sleeping in My Room with Her Stomach Exposed
弓道部の美人な先輩が、俺の部屋でお腹出して寝てる

193032.synopsis:
Being poor doesn’t mean you’re unhappy.
Dohui had been living like any other college student — working part-time to cover his living expenses, studying, getting through each day in a busy blur — when Jinho came to him with a favor.
— Just receive one thing for me. I’ll wire you 100 right away.
“……A hundred thousand won?”
— Did you think it was 100 won? I’m coming back to Korea this weekend, so I’ll head straight from the airport to your place. Just receive it and hold onto it, okay?
A million won, just for receiving a bag on someone else’s behalf.
Being poor didn’t make you unhappy — but even so, there was something helpless about the way money could undo you.
So if he hadn’t been poor. If he hadn’t been swayed by that money — wouldn’t Dohui’s life have stayed ordinary?
“I thought it had to be someone with some serious nerve — and it turns out it was just some clueless idiot.”
“I…… I really, r-really didn’t. Please believe me.”
“You should’ve at least known what it was worth before you took it. Then you might’ve run away a little more carefully.”
“……I’m, I’m sorry. I didn’t — it wasn’t like that…… I only did what I was asked……. Still, since it was your things, Director…… hic…….”
He never could have imagined it, not even in his dreams.
That the bag Jinho asked him to hold would have drugs inside.
That a friend would use him — and betray him.
“……Are you going to k*ll me? Like that person…… are you going to k*ll me too?”
“Why would I?”
“…….”

196616.synopsis:
One had to be careful of the Demon King who appeared on Gray Mountain, for he was beautiful and kind.
Yuers, a blessed land with Gray Mountain as its roof and the Abev River, split into two branches, surrounding it.
Founded by the hero Rassel Angmar, who defeated the Demon King, and blessed by the archmage Gill Kashutra, who had been loved by God, Yuers had enjoyed an era of peace and prosperity for five hundred years.
After all, who could have known that a Demon King would suddenly appear after five hundred years?
The one who volunteered to subjugate the Demon King all on his own was the hero Gillian Arke.
‘You will never become a father.’
‘You will die alone and lonely.’
‘No one will remember you.’
Can the introverted Hero, burdened even with the curse of a short life, defeat the Demon King and protect Yuers’s peace before his life comes to an end?

228104.synopsis:
As a top-tier transmigrator, Mu Yu’s final assessment was a high-difficulty world bundle with a survival rate of only 0.001%.
His sole mission was to survive at the hands of the blackened, beautiful, strong, yet tragic villains who were utterly insane, cold-blooded, tyrannical, and stopped at nothing.
Due to a system glitch, Mu Yu transmigrated too early.
